Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • GREEN HAIR, pale skin — NOT green skin.
  • Green eyes; water-dish (sara) on the head; turtle shell on the back.
  • Pale-blue + white yukata, yellow obi.
  • Sunlit, warm high-key — his scenes are daylit. Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
